meta.method: def-use window over corpus_sites strict 0x36 sites + directed Rosetta alignment of every strict site into the old-compiler binaries (1619 primary, LX1900/CX6DX/8008 secondary) by const fingerprint; position-strict known-op idiom classification at the aligned position
meta.verdict_rule: H-36-eq-usage iff classified pairs >= 5 and eq share >= 0.90 and ord share <= 0.05; ord cluster >= 3 pairs above the gate = mixed axis (conflict, no verdict)

const-prop.verdict: sites exist but the predicate outcome is not statically observable (no reachability); not a V support form offline

meta.rosetta_1619_strict_leg: empty: both 1619 code-mask 0x36 sites are non-strict data-region words (0x24e764/0x24e780); mask-only is never proof
meta.imm_field_note: imm-form clusters carry a real sub-dominant structure: masked field tests whose (shift, width) match the producer (i6, f5) -- 59/284 masked pairs in this production run (59/247 in the exploration run), while the unmasked const-compare consts equal i6 in only 14/2226 pairs (version drift confound, cf. CR-index drift 0x9887/0x9948/0x9307); below the dominance gate -> no separate verdict, parked for cycle B
meta.ord_gate_note: ord-family detection is conservative: any flag-writing word between the setter and its cc3/cc4 consumer rejects the candidate; ordering idioms with a clobbered flag path are not counted (ord share is a lower bound)
ceiling: Rosetta strict-sites of 0x36 in 1619: 0 (mask-only code-mask sites: 2 -- data-region words, not proof per Global Constraints)
in-corpus dual encoding (cmp.w with the same operand pair within +-12 words of a reg-form producer): 0 sites
const-prop V-form: 183 sites, outcome not statically observable (no reachability analysis offline)
imm-form (i6!=0): aligned compare consts drift with versions (C==i6 in 14/2226 pairs); field(shift=i6,width=f5) structure sub-dominant (59/284 masked pairs) -> no model-grade static verdict
meta.template_drift_note: cross-version aligned 0x36 sites freely interchange f5 inside {2,3,4}, {8}, {9,10,11} (same wait-loop template instantiated with f5=0xb/0xa/9 in 4030/LX1900/CX6DX); recorded as drift_pairs, not verdict-grade
